name: Elainedeuse
source:
[url=/c109881]Shidara Leitos[/url]'s contract spirit and secretary. Elaine is intelligent and calm, but can also be ruthless at certain times. [spoiler]She is one of Corticarte's sisters as well as one of the original founder spirits.[/spoiler]
